tasks.short: Calculate tax liabilities and populate returns from verified client information and approved tax positions.

steps.what: Read client documents and approved tax positions to assemble the calculation workpaper.

loop.input: Client documents, verified case record and approved tax positions.
loop.output: Calculation workpaper with source references and unresolved fields.
loop.check: Validate identifiers, periods, amounts and totals; retain a source reference for every extracted figure.
loop.stop: At most two extraction passes per document; unresolved or conflicting fields go to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured imports handle known formats; varied statements and correspondence require bounded text extraction.

steps.what: Enter workpaper amounts and approved positions into tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Run calculations and populate forms in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Reconcile return totals against workpapers and prior-year amounts in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Resolve exceptions and approve the return for client review in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configured imports feed verified amounts into tax preparation software in the {OTHER}; a bounded extractor prepares unfamiliar documents from the {DOCS}. Deterministic checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconcile the draft and create an exception queue in the {WORKFLOW}. The preparer approves release for client review; filing requires a separate authorised action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Calculation software already handles much of the arithmetic. Variable documents, duplicate entry and disconnected workpapers leave manual work around it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing import functions and faster development of mappings and reconciliation checks reduce setup effort. Bounded extraction can handle variable documents when every figure remains traceable.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining jurisdiction-specific rules, handling amended returns and resolving inconsistent evidence remain costly. The solution depends on maintained tax software rather than rebuilding tax law.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer recognises when apparently valid figures represent the wrong tax treatment and accepts responsibility for the reviewed return.

ambition.what: Review a client's estimated year-end liability after each quarterly bookkeeping close.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from entry and arithmetic to exception resolution and quarterly liability reviews. No new filing authority follows automatically; the preparer can propose earlier reviews within the engagement.

reach.task: Reconcile the closing ledger to the tax calculation workpaper.
reach.learn: Learn ledger account mapping, cut-off checks and the treatment of book-to-tax differences.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with income and corporate tax returns while leaving the user responsible.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reports faster statement checks and tests of details using DataSnipper; these are vendor-reported audit outcomes, not tax-return outcomes.
Tax arithmetic and form population are usually existing software capabilities; additional gains come from imports and exception checks.

assumptions: The setting is a tax services practice with 200 to 2,000 staff serving individuals and small businesses.
The first release covers one jurisdiction and a small set of supported return types.
The {OTHER} is maintained tax preparation software with supported imports.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates, not observed measurements.
The near-total automation prior fits arithmetic better than the complete task, which includes source validation and approval.
Build ranges cover an incremental solution and access review, including employee consultation where national rules apply.
unknowns: Which return types, jurisdictions and tax software versions the practice uses.
Whether supported imports and calculation exports are available.
How often source documents conflict or require corrections.
Who may approve client release and subsequent filing.
research_questions: Which supported import formats preserve source references and tax rule versions?
Which official validation checks can be reproduced independently without duplicating the tax engine?
new_work: Review extracted fields and resolve document conflicts.
Maintain account mappings and regression cases for annual rule changes.
Investigate failed imports and reconcile corrected records.
Review access, retention and employee consultation requirements under GDPR and national rules; assess EU AI Act duties for the intended use.

tasks.short: Identify lawful adjustments, deductions and credits, then select supported tax positions with the client.

steps.what: Read the client file for facts that may support deductions, credits or adjustments.

loop.input: Client evidence and a maintained catalogue of potential tax reliefs.
loop.output: Relief candidate list with supporting facts, source references and missing evidence.
loop.check: Every candidate must cite client evidence and an applicable catalogue entry; unsupported candidates are excluded.
loop.stop: One classification pass and one repair pass per case; uncertain matches go to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Eligibility filters are deterministic, but narrative evidence describes relevant facts in varied language.

steps.what: Check eligibility conditions and evidence requirements against current guidance in the {DOCS}.
Calculate supported alternatives in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Discuss choices, missing evidence and consequences with the client.
Approve supported positions and record rationale in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A maintained eligibility catalogue in the {DOCS} supplies deterministic checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM}; a bounded reader links narrative client evidence to possible reliefs. Tax preparation software in the {OTHER} calculates supported alternatives, while the {WORKFLOW} tracks missing evidence. The preparer discusses choices and approves positions before they enter the working return.
tasks.previous_blocker: Client facts are scattered across documents, and eligibility conditions change by jurisdiction and year. Standard software calculates entered claims but does not establish every supporting fact.
tasks.enabler_now: Small evidence-matching loops and reusable eligibility checks make a candidate workpaper practical. Faster implementation reduces the cost of connecting that workpaper to existing scenario calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous eligibility, interactions between reliefs and uncertain client facts need professional judgement. A lower tax amount alone does not establish that a position is lawful or suitable.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer interprets uncertain facts, weighs defensibility and explains consequences the client may otherwise overlook.

ambition.what: Offer a pre-year-end relief planning review to small-business clients.

tasks.altitude: The preparer spends less time searching files and more time assessing alternatives before deadlines. They gain room to recommend a planning review; approval authority remains subject to the practice's existing limits.

reach.task: Plan cash availability for estimated tax payments.
reach.learn: Learn cash forecasting and how tax elections change payment timing as well as total liability.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas provides assistance within income and corporate tax preparation; the digest does not establish autonomous relief selection.
Known eligibility conditions and scenario arithmetic can be encoded, while ambiguous tax positions require professional review.

assumptions: The initial catalogue covers common reliefs in one jurisdiction and tax year.
Qualified tax staff maintain the catalogue and approve its legal interpretation.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
The judgement-heavy prior is credible; automation addresses evidence matching and calculation more strongly than position selection.
Build ranges include access review and any employee consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which reliefs dominate the client portfolio.
Which positions require senior tax adviser approval.
Whether the {OTHER} supports separate scenario records.
How much time currently goes into eligibility research and evidence chasing.
research_questions: Which relief conditions can be encoded reliably from authoritative guidance?
How should conflicting guidance and effective dates be represented without implying certainty?
new_work: Maintain relief conditions, effective dates and authoritative references.
Review missed and irrelevant candidate reliefs.
Resolve incomplete evidence and route ambiguous positions to a senior tax adviser.
Maintain scenario isolation so exploratory alternatives cannot overwrite approved positions.
Apply GDPR controls to client evidence and assess EU AI Act duties for the intended use.

tasks.short: Explain tax form requirements and give clients advice that helps them provide correct information.

steps.what: Read the client's question and identify the relevant return fields in the {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Client question and authorised case context.
loop.output: Question brief with relevant fields, missing facts and a routine or specialist route.
loop.check: Check client and tax year; require a quoted question and valid return-field references.
loop.stop: One classification and one repair pass; uncertain or consequential questions route to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Clients describe form problems in free text that does not match fixed field names.

steps.what: Find current instructions and relevant case evidence in the {DOCS}.
Write case-specific instructions and explanations in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Question brief, current source pack and approved case facts.
loop.output: Draft client advice with field instructions, references and explicit unresolved questions.
loop.check: Check every tax claim against the source pack and every amount against the case; flag unsupported statements.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved claims remain flagged for the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Approved templates handle fixed instructions; varied client questions need a short case-specific explanation.

steps.what: Review and send written advice through the {EMAIL}.
Explain difficult points and check the client's understanding during a call.

tasks.design: An answer desk connects client questions in the {EMAIL} to a versioned guidance index and authorised case documents in the {DOCS}. Bounded classification and drafting produce a referenced response for preparer approval, and the {WORKFLOW} records follow-up questions. Difficult explanations stay with the preparer, supported by the same source pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance search and case-specific explanation were separate manual activities. Generic answers could miss the client's tax year, facts or actual misunderstanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned retrieval and bounded drafting make sourced preparation practical. Fixed field identifiers and approved templates keep routine instructions inexpensive.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting misunderstanding, explaining uncertain law and adapting to language or numeracy needs remain demanding. Advice quality depends on current guidance and complete client facts.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer notices confusion, asks a better question and helps the client understand the consequence of an answer.

ambition.what: Offer a guided first-return session for newly self-employed clients.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from repeated guidance searches and drafting to shorter reviews and focused explanations. The preparer can recommend guided sessions; no additional authority to settle tax positions is implied.

reach.task: Review client guidance for accuracy and required disclosures.
reach.learn: Learn guidance version control, disclosure requirements and escalation criteria.

evidence.claim: The digest documents an assistant in tax preparation, but does not demonstrate an end-to-end taxpayer advice desk.
Source retrieval, approved templates and reviewed drafting can reduce preparation work while leaving difficult explanations human.

assumptions: Guidance can be indexed by jurisdiction, tax year and return field.
This task starts with a client question; telephone-originated questions follow the same preparation path.
The mail prior is weak: written questions and written release make {EMAIL} a material part of this workflow.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
The elimination prior applies to repeated lookup and boilerplate more than to client understanding.
Build ranges include access review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: The actual mix of written questions, calls and appointments.
Which languages and accessibility needs the clients have.
Whether current guidance has stable identifiers and usable access rights.
Which advice requires a senior tax adviser to approve release.
research_questions: How can guidance updates invalidate affected draft answers automatically?
Which answer checks detect unsupported tax claims and incorrect field references?
new_work: Maintain guidance versions, approved templates and question routing.
Investigate answers that clients repeatedly misunderstand.
Check retrieval permissions and retention under GDPR, and assess applicable EU AI Act duties.

tasks.short: Interview clients to clarify income, expenses, allowances and gaps in their tax evidence.

steps.what: Review the client file and prepare questions about missing or inconsistent facts.

loop.input: Client documents, prior-year facts and outstanding evidence requests.
loop.output: Interview brief with referenced inconsistencies and suggested questions.
loop.check: Every factual premise must cite the file; checklist gaps are calculated deterministically.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unsupported premises are removed and uncertainty is shown.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed checklists find missing fields, but narrative conflicts need reading and case-specific questions.

steps.what: Arrange the interview through the {EMAIL} and {CALENDAR}.
Ask follow-up questions and take notes during the client interview.
Turn interview notes into a case summary and evidence request in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: The preparer's written interview notes and existing case fields.
loop.output: Draft case update and evidence request, separating client statements from verified facts.
loop.check: Every update cites a note; reconcile amounts and dates, and preserve uncertainty explicitly.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass; ambiguous notes remain unresolved for the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Written notes vary in wording and structure; fixed forms remain available for routine facts.

steps.what: Validate case updates and release the evidence request in tax software in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} prepares a referenced interview brief from the {DOCS} and configures booking through the {CALENDAR}. The preparer conducts the interview and supplies written notes; a bounded extractor drafts case updates and evidence requests. Approval commits the updates to tax preparation software in the {OTHER} and releases the request through the {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The interview depends on trust and adaptive questioning, while preparation and note transfer are scattered. Automating the entire conversation offered little benefit and introduced verification problems.
tasks.enabler_now: Brief generation, configured scheduling and bounded extraction from written notes can reduce the surrounding administration. These changes do not require an autonomous interviewer or call recording.
tasks.still_hard: Clients may be unsure, embarrassed or inconsistent about financial facts. A statement obtained in an interview may still require documentary evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer builds trust, notices hesitation and asks follow-up questions that reveal facts missing from the paperwork.

ambition.what: Provide assisted intake for first-time small-business clients with incomplete records.

tasks.altitude: Most interview time remains human; preparation and follow-up consume less of the week. The preparer can spend that capacity on assisted intake and request stronger evidence, while tax-position approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Organise incomplete income and expense records before tax preparation.
reach.learn: Learn document classification, basic reconciliations and how to distinguish an assertion from supporting evidence.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies interviews as work that stays with people.
Configured booking and reviewed extraction from written notes can reduce interview administration without automating the conversation.

assumptions: Interviews are conducted by telephone, video or in person; the modelled case uses a call.
The extractor uses written notes and does not depend on audio recording.
Scheduling uses authorised contacts, approved invitation text and available appointment slots.
The high vanishing prior is rejected for the conversation: the task retains its relationship and fact-finding purpose.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
Build ranges include access review and any employee consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: How much interview time currently goes into preparation and follow-up.
Whether notes are already structured and stored with the case.
Which clients need assisted intake or language support.
Whether case software can preserve the distinction between asserted and verified facts.
research_questions: Which note fields best preserve uncertainty and the source of client statements?
What retention and access controls apply when notes include special-category personal data?
new_work: Review interview briefs for misleading premises.
Validate drafted case updates against written notes.
Track requested evidence and distinguish outstanding assertions from verified facts.
Maintain intake checklists and booking rules.
Apply GDPR controls to interview records and assess relevant EU AI Act duties and consultation requirements under national rules.

role.altitude: The tax preparer spends less time transferring figures, searching guidance and rewriting notes. The week centres on disputed facts, defensible tax positions and client understanding; filing and advice authority remain subject to existing professional limits.
reach: Work with Accountants and Auditors on ledger-to-tax reconciliations.
Work with Financial Managers, Treasurers and Controllers on quarterly tax cash forecasts.
Work with Compliance Officers on guidance accuracy and advice escalation.
Work with Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks on assisted intake for incomplete records.
skills_to_grow: Design and interpret source-linked reconciliation checks.
Maintain jurisdiction-specific eligibility rules and effective dates.
Review model drafts for unsupported facts and tax claims.
Explain uncertainty and choices in plain language.
Use cash forecasts to time tax planning discussions.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a year-round small-business tax planning service combining quarterly liability reviews, pre-year-end relief planning and assisted intake, with qualified people approving consequential advice and tax positions.
